rubrics.justification: Correctly recognizes poor ICM/TE consistent with 1DD, but inaccurately calls it an expanded blastocyst with a large well-defined blastocoel and slightly thinned zona; the image/lab grade indicate an early blastocyst (stage 1) with only partial blastocoel expansion.

Integrates age, ovarian reserve, sperm quality, BMI/lifestyle, tubal factor, and endometrial thickness with the poor embryo grade, appropriately identifying embryo quality as the main limiting factor, though some claims about egg quality/euploidy are somewhat overstated.

Overall logic is understandable and the low implantation estimate fits the poor morphology, but there are notable inconsistencies such as describing grade 1 as expanded and stating transfer is better than waiting for a Day 6 embryo/canceling without sufficient basis.

Some elements are aligned (poor prognosis for 1DD, counseling, SET generally reasonable), but recommending PGT-A as highly recommended in a 33-year-old first cycle and suggesting freeze-all/claims about ideal lining and transfer superiority are not well supported by standard guidelines.
Provides practical counseling points and broad transfer/future-cycle suggestions, but recommendations are somewhat generic and include questionable advice rather than nuanced case-specific planning.
